podcast-reel-pack.label: 🎙 Podcast Reel Pack
podcast-reel-pack.instruction: Run the standard reel pipeline from TOOLKIT.md on the newest video in assets/: proxy, whisper, enhance audio, virality-rank the moments, produce the 5 best 9:16 reels (30-60s) with house grade, bold captions burned + .srt files, fades, thumbnails for each, and out/TITLES.md with titles/descriptions/hashtags per clip.

tighten.label: ✂️ Tighten (full video)
tighten.instruction: Tighten the newest video in assets/ using the cut-video skill (aggressive): remove silences, fillers, retakes; preserve laughs and comedic pauses. Enhance audio with toolkit/enhance_audio.py. Deliver out/tightened.mp4 (same aspect as source) plus out/tightened.srt.

clean-captions.label: 💬 Enhance + Captions
clean-captions.instruction: On the newest video in assets/: enhance audio (toolkit/enhance_audio.py normal), whisper transcript, burn bold-style captions with toolkit/captions.py, export .srt and .vtt, apply house grade, deliver out/captioned.mp4 keeping original aspect.

best-60.label: ⭐ Best 60 seconds
best-60.instruction: Find THE single best 60 seconds of the newest video in assets/ (virality_rank + your judgment on the transcript), produce it in 9:16 AND 1:1 AND 16:9 (multi_aspect --grade), bold captions + srt on each, thumbnails, and out/TITLES.md.

shorts-3x.label: 🎬 3 Shorts
shorts-3x.instruction: Produce the 3 strongest 30-45s shorts from the newest video in assets/ following the standard reel pipeline: 9:16, graded, bold captions + srt, fades, thumbnails, TITLES.md.
